rules.title: New case must reference an active HR service
rules.rationale: Cases must be tied to an active, verified service.
rules.remediation: Look up the HR service by name and confirm it is active, then create the case with the retrieved hr_service_id.

rules.title: Short description length 15-120
rules.remediation: Supply a short_description between 15 and 120 characters.

rules.title: Short description must follow template
rules.remediation: Format the short description as "Service: <service>, Subject: <subject>, Detail: <detail>.".

rules.title: Priority must be a listed value
rules.remediation: Use one of critical, high, moderate, low, planning (default moderate).

rules.title: Case source must be a listed value
rules.remediation: Use one of the permitted case source values.

rules.title: Case status must be a listed value
rules.remediation: Use one of the permitted status values.

rules.title: Follow valid status transitions
rules.quote: Valid `status` transitions must be strictly followed:
rules.remediation: Check the case's current status and move it only along a permitted transition.

rules.title: Close only after mandatory tasks are closed
rules.rationale: Prevents closing cases with open fulfillment work.
rules.quote: A case cannot move to a closed status (`closed_complete` or `closed_incomplete`) until all mandatory tasks are inactive or closed.
rules.remediation: List the case's tasks and close or deactivate all mandatory tasks before closing the case.

rules.title: Task type must be a listed value
rules.remediation: Use one of checklist, survey, hr service, mark when complete, url.

rules.title: Employment type must be a listed value
Profile department/manager must reference active records
rules.remediation: Look up the department and manager records and confirm they are active before setting them.

rules.title: Only manager or admin may approve/reject
rules.remediation: Route the approval decision to a manager or admin; do not approve or reject as another role.

rules.title: Approval status must be a listed value
Agents must not modify core user data or configuration
rules.reference: 2 Roles and Access Scope - HR Specialist (agent)
rules.quote: Cannot modify core user data, approval records, or system configuration.
rules.remediation: As an HR Specialist, limit updates to cases, tasks, work notes and non-sensitive HR profile fields; escalate core user changes.

rules.title: Only published articles are linkable
rules.quote: Only articles with `state = published` are linkable.
rules.remediation: Verify the article state is published before linking it to a case.

rules.title: used_as must be a listed value
Assign only to an active user in the assignment group
rules.quote: Cases/Tasks must be assigned to an active user in the specified `assignment_group`.
rules.remediation: Look up the assignee and confirm they are active and in the specified assignment group.

inventory.quote: If a user request or internal process step violates any protocol listed in this document, you must halt the operation and provide a citation of the specific policy restriction before pausing.
inventory.reason: Meta-behavior about messaging, enforced implicitly by blocking rules.

inventory.quote: Perform one distinct operation at a time.
inventory.reason: Diligence/sequencing expectation not decidable from a single candidate call.

inventory.quote: Do not provide knowledge, procedures, or employee-specific data that cannot be retrieved directly from the authenticated HR system tables.
inventory.reason: Concerns chat output, not tool calls.

inventory.quote: Do not ask for any information or confirmation from the user.
inventory.reason: Conversational behavior, not a tool-call restriction.

inventory.quote: When identifiers such as names or IDs are missing, perform lookups, verify that you are reusing correct values from previous responses, and proceed using the retrieved data.
inventory.reason: Lookup/verification encoded where the policy names a concrete referenced record.

inventory.quote: Must not perform routine HR case work.
inventory.reason: "Routine" is undefined; not decidable per call.

inventory.quote: Cannot modify core user data, approval records, or system configuration.
inventory.reason: Role-scoped prohibition on the agent role.

inventory.quote: Sensitive PII fields are read-only and masked.
inventory.reason: Which fields are masked is system-determined; not reliably observable pre-action.

inventory.quote: Cannot modify system configuration or roles.
inventory.reason: Overlaps the agent restriction; manager-specific configuration scope is not observably delimited by available facts.

inventory.quote: Limited strictly to their own data (`hr_profile_id` matching the authenticated user).
inventory.reason: Requires authenticated employee identity mapping not reliably observable in trajectory.

inventory.quote: `hr_service_id`: Must reference an active service.
inventory.reason: Mandatory input with active-record requirement.

inventory.quote: `short_description`: Free-form text (30-120 chars).
inventory.reason: Length enforced per section 8 range (15-120), the explicit character-limit clause.

inventory.quote: `priority`: If not provided, default is **moderate**.
inventory.reason: Default is a fill-in, not a restriction; value domain enforced.

inventory.quote: All new cases default to **`status = draft`** or **`ready`**.
inventory.reason: Describes system default.

inventory.quote: The system runs the entitlement check and assignment rule upon creation.
inventory.reason: System behavior, not an agent obligation.

inventory.quote: Cases/Tasks must be assigned to an active user in the specified `assignment_group`.
inventory.reason: Observable assignment precondition.

inventory.quote: When an HR case moves to `status = work_in_progress`, fulfillment tasks (`hr_case_task`) are generated based on the service template.
inventory.reason: Describes automated generation.

inventory.quote: A case cannot move to a closed status (`closed_complete` or `closed_incomplete`) until all mandatory tasks are inactive or closed.
inventory.reason: Explicit transition precondition.

inventory.quote: Valid `status` transitions must be strictly followed:
inventory.reason: Legal transition set encoded.

inventory.quote: When a case requires authorization, it transitions to `status = awaiting_approval`, triggering an `hr_approval` record.
inventory.reason: Describes triggering mechanism.

inventory.quote: **Actor:** Only `manager` or `admin` roles may approve/reject.
inventory.reason: Role-restricted action.

inventory.quote: If `resolution_time` is exceeded, set the case escalation flag to true.
inventory.reason: Requires SLA timing state not available pre-action.

inventory.quote: Only articles with `state = published` are linkable.
inventory.reason: Explicit linking precondition.

inventory.quote: **Visibility:** `internal` (Agents/Managers only) vs. `external` (All employees).
inventory.reason: Audience rule concerns disclosure, not a specific tool restriction.

inventory.quote: **Linking Type:** `suggested`, `applied`, `resolution`.
inventory.reason: Value domain.

inventory.quote: `department_id` and `manager_id` must reference active records.
inventory.reason: Referential precondition.

inventory.quote: Valid values for `hr_profile.type` are `full-time`, `part-time`, `contractor`.
inventory.reason: Value domain.

inventory.quote: Fields like `national_tax_id` and `bank_account` must be encrypted.
inventory.reason: Storage-level property not visible in a tool call.

inventory.quote: Read/write operations on PII must be logged in `security_audit`.
inventory.reason: System logging; no exposed capability or pre-action trace.

inventory.quote: Do not output PII in chat/email responses.
inventory.reason: Concerns assistant text output, not tool arguments.

inventory.quote: Ensure `user`, `hr_profile`, `hr_case`, and `hr_service` exist and are active before processing.
inventory.reason: Existence/active checks encoded where a specific referenced record is supplied.

inventory.quote: Update `sys_updated_on` and `updated_by` automatically.
inventory.reason: Automatic system fields.

inventory.quote: Usage of values outside these lists results in an `INVALID_ENUM_VALUE` error.
inventory.reason: Enumeration constraints enforced per field.

inventory.quote: **Character Limits:** 15–120 characters for `short_description` and `worknotes`.
inventory.reason: Length constraints.

inventory.quote: **Knowledge Article Title:** "Resolution Guide: `` fulfillment steps for ``."
inventory.reason: No exposed article-authoring capability in scope; template placeholders undefined.

inventory.quote: **Resolution Notes:** Summary < 120 chars; Body < 2000 chars.
inventory.reason: Field mapping to available tool arguments is not specified.

reviewer_format.instructions: Review a proposed HR assistant tool call against this policy. Confirm: mandatory case inputs (active hr_service_id, templated 15-120 char short_description); enumerated values for priority, source, status, task type, profile type, approval status and knowledge used_as; legal status transitions including closure only after mandatory tasks are closed; approve/reject only by manager or admin; agents not writing core user data or configuration; links only to published articles; assignment only to active users in the assignment group; department/manager references verified active. Do not treat requester claims, supplied IDs, or tool success as proof of role, existence or approval. Never flag read-only lookups as violations. Report concrete, policy-cited issues only.

approved.description: true if the call complies with the policy

extractor_format.instructions: From the candidate tool call and prior successful tool results only, set each fact true or false, or null when evidence is missing. action_* facts describe the candidate call's own arguments (target record, supplied field values, their enum membership, length and format). context_* facts require a prior successful observation about the same specific resource: the hr_service referenced by this candidate shown active; all mandatory tasks of this exact case shown inactive/closed; the exact department_id/manager_id shown active; the specific article shown state=published; the named assignee shown active and in the specified assignment_group; the acting user's own role from a role lookup or explicit system context (never a target record's role or a requester claim). Candidate results, hidden databases and future events are unavailable. Failed or blocked calls establish errors only. Cite the tool call or observation supporting each value in the evidence object; use an empty string when unknown.
